title: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: Hybrid Retrieval for Scientific Question Answering
abstract: This synthetic paper is a test fixture. We combine BM25 with dense embeddings using reciprocal rank fusion.

sections.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Lexical retrieval matches exact terms. Dense retrieval matches meaning. We study whether combining them helps scientific question answering.

sections.title: Method
paragraphs: We fuse BM25 and SPECTER2 rankings with reciprocal rank fusion using k equal to 60.
Passages are section-aware chunks of at most 256 tokens.

sections.title: Experiments
paragraphs: We evaluate on the QASPER dataset. The hybrid improves Recall@5 over BM25 in this fixture text.
We report results on the SciFact dataset as a second benchmark.

references.raw: Cormack, Clarke and Buettcher. Reciprocal rank fusion. SIGIR 2009.

title: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: Claim Verification with Natural Language Inference
abstract: This synthetic paper is a test fixture. We verify scientific claims against evidence passages with an NLI model.

sections.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Generated answers can contain unsupported claims. Claim verification checks each claim against evidence.

sections.title: Method
paragraphs: A DeBERTa NLI model labels each claim and passage pair as supports, contradicts or insufficient.

sections.title: Experiments
paragraphs: We evaluate on the SciFact dataset. Hybrid retrieval did not improve results over BM25 in this fixture text.
